preparation.title: Tune and recheck all six strings
Form D and check each sounding string
Form A and check each sounding string
Move between D and A with a light anchor
Understand how to count alternating changes
Count four beats and attempt suitable A/D songs

blocks.title: Tune
blocks.prompt: Use your tuner to check low E2, A2, D3, G3, B3 and high E4. Make small adjustments, then recheck every string. Extend this block whenever you need.
blocks.selfCheck: I checked all six strings and rechecked after adjusting.

blocks.title: D chord accuracy
blocks.prompt: Place D, strum from string 4, then pick strings 4, 3, 2 and 1 individually. Correct an unclear note and strum again. Repeat slowly with a relaxed hand.
blocks.selfCheck: I listened to each intended string and adjusted unclear notes.

blocks.title: A chord accuracy
blocks.prompt: Place A, strum from string 5, then pick strings 5, 4, 3, 2 and 1 individually. Correct an unclear note and strum again. Repeat slowly with a relaxed hand.
blocks.selfCheck: I listened to each intended string and adjusted unclear notes.

blocks.title: Silent A/D anchor movement
blocks.prompt: Form D lightly. Lift fingers 2 and 3; keep the index touching string 3 and shift it slightly within fret 2. Place fingers 2 and 3 for A, then reverse. Keep contact light; no strum is needed.
blocks.selfCheck: I tried both directions without gripping hard.

blocks.title: Changes, starting on A
blocks.prompt: Form A before starting; that setup is zero. Change to D and strum: one. Change back to A and strum: two. Continue alternating. Count the formed destination changes yourself; this speed exercise is separate from clean-sound accuracy practice.
blocks.selfCheck: I counted changes rather than counting the starting shape.

blocks.title: Changes, starting on D
blocks.prompt: Form D before starting; that setup is zero. Change to A and strum: one. Change back to D and strum: two. Continue alternating and count the formed destination changes yourself.
blocks.selfCheck: I counted changes rather than counting the starting shape.

blocks.title: Two-chord songs
blocks.prompt: Choose a suitable A/D song you have learned. Play manageable sections slowly, count the bars, and revisit the places that need another pass. Use material that fits your tuning and available capo. Song practice stays part of the routine.
blocks.selfCheck: I attempted musical sections, even if they were imperfect.
